card.text: The closest known moon to Uranus, shepherding the epsilon ring's inner edge.

introduction.text: Cordelia and Ophelia keep the particles of Uranus's epsilon ring from spreading out. Voyager 2 found Cordelia in 1986.

model.title: Shape approximation
model.summary: A 50 × 36 × 36 km shape from Voyager, with two axes assumed equal; there are no surface images.
